title: GLOW POOLS: THE FORGE, FORGED GUNS AND ELEMENTS LIGHT THE WORLD
why: His 10-12 graphics list, idea I5: the game registered glow sources every frame (forge furnace, forged gun, burning, shocked and frozen bodies) and nothing read them. They now add a coloured pool to the light map and one cached halo sprite each before the fog, no blur. POST FX joins the quality ladder (shed with the HUD and weather rung), scales with effect intensity, and its hint says what it does.
now: The forge and the elements cast a soft coloured light on the ground and a gentle halo; POST FX off, effect intensity 0 or a busy frame removes it.
